title: Sabah çayı

characters.WIFE: a woman in her thirties with long black hair in a braid, wearing a teal sweater
characters.HUSBAND: a man in his thirties with short brown hair and a short beard, wearing a mustard yellow sweater

scenes.text:
Eşinle tartışmayı kazandığın gece,
neden yine de uyuyamadın?
scenes.prompt: At night in a dark bedroom, {WIFE} lies awake in bed looking up at the ceiling, pale moonlight through the window, rain on the glass.

scenes.text:
Haklıydın;
bütün cümleleri sen kurdun, o sustu.
scenes.prompt: In a living room in the evening, {WIFE} on the left stands and talks with a frown, while {HUSBAND} on the right sits on the sofa looking down silently, warm lamp light.

scenes.text:
Ama yatağın iki ucunda,
sırt sırta uzandınız.
scenes.prompt: At night in a bedroom lit by soft moonlight, {WIFE} and {HUSBAND} lie at the two far edges of the bed, turned away from each other, rain on the window.

scenes.text:
Sabah biri sessizce
iki bardak çay koydu masaya.
scenes.prompt: In a kitchen at sunrise, {HUSBAND} stands beside the table with a shy smile, two glasses of tea on the table, looking toward the doorway, golden light and autumn leaves outside the window.

scenes.text:
Evlilikte haklı olan değil, önce çayı koyan kazanır.
Bunu eşine gönder.
scenes.prompt: In the sunny kitchen in the morning, {WIFE} on the left and {HUSBAND} on the right sit at the table smiling at each other, two glasses of tea between them, an autumn tree outside the window.

caption:
Haklı olmak yetmez.

Bazen barışmak bir bardak çay kadar yakındır. 🤍

Bunu eşine gönder.
